name: Argentiferous-Corbel
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
